content: User asked: 'What about the trail-as-product idea could that be a case' after the create-plugin skill landed. Offered three readings (repo skill for the cycle-logging procedure, a portable account-level skill, building the missing planner/maker/checker/reflector role plugins) via AskUserQuestion; user selected all three plus free text 'allabove'. Opened this cycle to close the two repo-scoped gaps (cycle-logging skill + the four missing role plugins); the account-skill proposal is handled separately via propose_skills, outside this trail's file-owning roles.
